printed: Place (only 'PL.' printed here; the same street is labelled HIGHLAND further south)
note: A narrow 'PL.' (3463) runs south from Maple St and does not continue north of it. Maple is printed 'MAPLE' to the west and 'ST.' to the east.

printed: ...ICH (Norwich, cut off by the plate edge)
note: Baxter runs east-west and turns south here; the southern leg is also printed BAXTER (today's Norwich?). The '...ICH' street leaves NNW from the corner at the plate cut. The streets are half outside the plate.

printed: Avenue (only 'AVE.' printed; this is the streetcar avenue that is printed ALBANY further west, today's Erkenbrecher)
note: This is about 527 px south of the expected point. At the expected point (5797, 4332) another 'AVE.' meets Burnet as a T. Its name is not printed in the region, and it does not have the streetcar tracks that ALBANY has. I picked the y 4860 avenue because it lines up with ALBANY (y 4889 at x 2800) and the tracks curve into Burnet there. 68_019 is the same crossing.
Carplin Pl. runs south from Carplin (east-west) and meets the bottom 'AVE.' as a T. The south half of the avenue is cut by the plate's bottom edge, so its centre is estimated.

An east-west street printed 'WEST' meets Vine from the east, about 110 px north of the expected point. Vine's west side is cut off by the plate edge, so its centreline is estimated from the east building line and the car tracks. The other streets nearby are TOWER ST (y 3070) and an AVE stub (y 1535).

printed: Avenue (only 'AVE.' printed; the streetcar avenue that is printed ALBANY further west, today's Erkenbrecher)
note: The avenue (y 4815-4905) meets Burnet (x 5752-5840) as a T, and the streetcar tracks curve from the avenue into Burnet. It does not continue east of Burnet. I identified it as Erkenbrecher because it continues ALBANY, which is printed at y 4889 at x 2800. The name is not printed in this region.

printed: M... (cut off by the plate edge)
note: A short stub (y 1797-1877) leaves the east side of Reading Road and is cut by the plate edge right away, with an 'M' visible. There is no matching street on the west side.
Irving St (centre x about 2363) ends at y 2240 and opens west into Forest Ave through a short gap (y 2187-2240). I picked where the centre of that opening meets Forest's centreline.

printed: (no name printed; stub cut by the plate edge)
note: A stub (y 2754-2808) leaves the east side of Reading Road and is cut by the plate edge. Other streets meet Reading from the west at y 2597 and y 3175 (both unnamed) and there is another east stub at y 3175. None is named Hutchins.

ALBANY (today's Erkenbrecher) runs east-west with its centre at y 4889. The north-south 'AVE.' (centre x 2822, likely today's Euclid) starts at y 5160, at the rear line of lots 72/73, and runs south to Louis St. A full block of lots lies between them, so in 1922 the two streets do not meet.

EHRMAN comes in diagonally from the NW and continues east as the street at y about 1021. The north-south leg printed BAXTER (today's Norwich?) ends at it. The west part of the junction is close to the plate's cut edge.

GLENWOOD AVE runs east-west at y about 1000, with the plate edge just north of it. South of it near the expected point is acreage (Mary H. Gamble, Doepke Co., Heinsheimer), with no street. A dead-end 'PL.' (x about 6790, 3566-69) stops at y about 1667, well short of Glenwood. An unnamed north-south 'AVE.' meets Glenwood's east end at about (7758, 1000).

printed: ...VE. (Avenue, name cut off by the plate edge)
note: A short 'AVE.' stub (y 1500-1570) leaves the west side of Vine and is cut by the plate edge right away. Another unnamed west stub is at y about 1060.
HIGHLAND (the same street that is the 'PL.' at Maple) curves south and ends at HALE as a T.

printed: Avenue (only 'AVE.' printed here; HARVEY further south)

same_names_elsewhere.note: PROSPECT meets the same avenue from the east as a T. It is just as far from the expected point (190 px against 183 px), so it may be today's Northern.
